# 一段合成的"工具输出"样例：里面既有真实形态的秘密，也有必须原样保留的正常内容。
# 所有凭据都是编造的假值。
$ env | grep -Ei 'key|token|secret'
OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789
AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE
AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMN
GITHUB_TOKEN=ghp_abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789
SLACK_TOKEN=xoxb-1234567890-abcdefghij
GOOGLE_API_KEY=AIzaAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA
$ cat ~/.config/app/credentials.json
{"user":"alice","password":"hunter2hunter2","region":"eu-west-1"}
$ curl -H "Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiIxMjM0NTY3ODkwIn0.dBjftJeZ4CVPmB92K27uhbUJU1p1r_wW1gFWFOEjXk" https://api.example.com/v1/items
{"items":[],"requestId":"123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000"}
$ git log -1 --format=%H
